list.name: Concurrency level
list.expr: count_values("c", max(min_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace_a|$namespace_b"}[1m]) > 0 and stddev_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace_a|$namespace_b"}[1m]) == 0)) unless on (c) count_values("c", max_over_time((max(min_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace_a|$namespace_b"}[1m]) > 0 and stddev_over_time(dynamo_frontend_inflight_requests{namespace=~"$namespace_a|$namespace_b"}[1m]) == 0))[5m:15s] offset 1m))
list.textFormat: Concurrency plateau: {{c}} in-flight requests at the frontend (sweep step)

description: KubeCon NA 2026: baseline vs optimized, side by side. Each arm is one scenario namespace (one DynamoGraphDeployment per namespace), picked with $namespace_a (Baseline) and $namespace_b (Optimized). SGLang engine metrics and HiCache tiers. Set the time range to cover both runs; the (selected range) stats aggregate over all of it. Panels illustrate; the demo-bench tables are the numbers of record.

panels.title: TTFT p50 (selected range)
panels.description: Median time to first token at the Dynamo frontend, from the histogram over the whole selected time range: narrow the range to the two runs you compare, since everything in the range counts (warm-ups and other reps included).

panels.title: TTFT p95 (selected range)
panels.description: 95th-percentile time to first token at the Dynamo frontend, from the histogram over the whole selected time range: narrow the range to the two runs you compare, since everything in the range counts (warm-ups and other reps included).

panels.title: Engine hit rate (selected range)
panels.description: SGLang prefix-cache hit rate = increase(sglang:cached_tokens_total) / increase(sglang:prompt_tokens_total) over the whole selected time range: narrow the range to the two runs you compare, since everything in the range counts (warm-ups and other reps included).

panels.title: Output tokens/s (selected range)
panels.description: Output tokens per second at the Dynamo frontend, averaged over the whole selected time range: narrow the range to the two runs you compare, since everything in the range counts (warm-ups and other reps included). Idle time lowers it.

panels.title: TTFT p50 over time
panels.description: Median time to first token per arm, at the Dynamo frontend.

panels.title: TTFT p95 over time
panels.description: 95th-percentile time to first token per arm, at the Dynamo frontend.

panels.title: ITL p95 over time
panels.description: 95th-percentile inter-token latency per arm, from the SGLang engine histogram.

panels.title: In-flight requests per arm
panels.description: Requests in flight at the Dynamo frontend per arm: the offered concurrency of each run.

panels.title: Engine hit rate per arm
panels.description: SGLang prefix-cache hit rate per arm = rate(sglang:cached_tokens_total) / rate(sglang:prompt_tokens_total), all worker pods of the namespace. The last-batch gauge is never used.

panels.title: Output tokens/s
panels.description: Output tokens per second at the Dynamo frontend, per arm.

panels.title: HiCache tiers (L1 device, L2 host, L3 storage)
Tokens by cache source
panels.description: Prompt tokens served from each cache tier (cache_source device / host / storage_<backend>; the "total" fallback series is excluded), stacked per arm over the tokens the engine had to compute (prompt minus cached). Baseline is dashed.

panels.title: HiCache host occupancy
panels.description: L2 (pinned host RAM) occupancy per arm, all worker pods: sum(sglang:hicache_host_used_tokens) / sum(sglang:hicache_host_total_tokens). No series when the arm runs without HiCache.

panels.title: HiCache load-back
panels.description: Tokens loaded back from L2 host RAM to the GPU per arm (sglang:load_back_tokens_total).

panels.title: HiCache prefetch
panels.description: L3 to L2 prefetched tokens (sglang:prefetched_tokens_total) and L2 to L3 backed-up tokens (sglang:backuped_tokens_total) per arm. Both need storage metrics enabled on the worker. Baseline is dashed.

panels.title: Cache tier occupancy (L1/L2/L3)
panels.description: Per arm, all worker pods. L1 device KV pool held by the radix cache = (sglang:kv_used_tokens + sglang:kv_evictable_tokens) / sglang:max_total_num_tokens. L2 host pool = sglang:hicache_host_used_tokens / sglang:hicache_host_total_tokens. L3 (right axis) = tokens written from L2 to L3 storage since the workers started (sglang:backuped_tokens_total): an upper bound, as SGLang 0.5.18 exports no L3 occupancy gauge. Baseline is dashed.

title: Dynamo on EKS: Baseline vs Optimized (KubeCon NA 2026)
